tech.onesa_desc1: Onesa AI is our proprietary model designed to illuminate the way on how to live, invest, and thrive in Zimbabwe. While general AI models often lack local nuance, Onesa is built from the ground up to understand the Zimbabwean context better than any other model.
tech.onesa_desc2: From navigating local regulations to brainstorming business ideas that solve specific Zimbabwean challenges, Onesa provides the localized intelligence you need to succeed.
tech.onesa_local_edge_desc: Standard models like GPT-4 or Claude are often Western-centric, excelling in formal economies but failing to navigate the "kukiya-kiya" (hustle) economy of Mbare Musika or the deep nuances of Shona slang mixed with rural Ndebele. Onesa understands these cultural textures.
tech.diaspora_unlocked_desc: We use cutting-edge technology to enable seamless tourism, trade, and investment. Our platform bridges the gap between the diaspora and local opportunities through digital transparency and AI-powered insights.
tech.ai_demo_response: Zimbabwe"s agriculture sector is currently seeing high growth in horticulture exports. Based on current trends, investing in cold-chain logistics for blueberry exports from the Eastern Highlands offers a high ROI with moderate risk...

eu_sanctions_easing.title: EU Sanctions Easing on Zimbabwe
eu_sanctions_easing.description: The European Union has eased sanctions on several Zimbabwean entities, opening new avenues for trade and investment. This move signals a positive shift in diplomatic relations and economic cooperation.

arms_embargo_expiration.title: Arms Embargo Expiration
arms_embargo_expiration.description: The EU"s arms embargo on Zimbabwe has officially expired, further normalizing trade relations. While direct impact on general exports is limited, it improves the overall investment climate.

eu_esa_epa_benefits.title: Benefits of EU-ESA EPA
eu_esa_epa_benefits.description: Zimbabwe benefits from duty-free, quota-free access to the EU market under the interim Economic Partnership Agreement (EPA) with the East and Southern Africa (ESA) region. This provides a significant competitive advantage for Zimbabwean products.
